usage: The word 煎餃 refers to a specific type of dumpling that is pan-fried to have a crispy outside.
煎餃 is used as a noun to name the dish, so it can act as the subject or object in a sentence.
You can use 煎餃 with quantifiers like 'jat1 go3' (one piece) or 'sap6 go3' (ten pieces) when ordering or counting.
It is common to mention sauces or dipping condiments with 煎餃 in questions or statements, as these affect how people eat it.
煎餃 can be combined with verbs like 'sik6' (to eat), 'be1' (to order), or 'zung1 ji3' (to like) when discussing preferences or actions.
